mission: REPLACE_GLOBAL_CARDINALITY-ONLY PERSISTENCE REASONING WITH THE EXACT FINITE MESSAGE COMPLEXITY CONDITION GIVEN JIT SIDE INFORMATION

setup.W: FINITE SET OF POSSIBLE TASK WORLDS
setup.A_w: NONEMPTY SET OF TERMINALLY ADEQUATE POLICIES FOR WORLD w
setup.T_w: COMPLETE EFFECTIVE NONPERSISTENT PRECOMMITMENT TRANSCRIPT AVAILABLE AFTER RESTART BEFORE DEADLINE
setup.M_w: PERSISTENT TASK MESSAGE RETAINED ACROSS RESTART
setup.decoder: AFTER RESTART THE FROZEN OWNED KERNEL CHOOSES A POLICY FROM (T_w,M_w)

theorem.tau_t: MINIMUM NUMBER OF POLICIES WHOSE ADEQUACY COVER SETS COVER W_t
theorem.statement: FOR THE DECLARED FINITE INSTANCE, THE MINIMUM NUMBER OF PERSISTENT MESSAGE STATES REQUIRED FOR GUARANTEED TERMINAL ADEQUACY IS EXACTLY R_star, AND THE MINIMUM FIXED-LENGTH MESSAGE BITS ARE EXACTLY B_star.
theorem.lower_bound_proof: FIX ANY TRANSCRIPT t. WITH R PERSISTENT MESSAGE STATES, THE DECODER CAN SELECT AT MOST R POLICIES FOR THAT t. THOSE POLICIES MUST COVER EVERY WORLD IN W_t. THEREFORE R >= tau_t FOR EVERY t, SO R >= MAX_t tau_t.
theorem.upper_bound_proof: FOR EACH t CHOOSE A MINIMUM POLICY COVER OF SIZE tau_t. REUSE GLOBAL MESSAGE LABELS 1..R_star ACROSS DIFFERENT TRANSCRIPT CELLS. ENCODE EACH WORLD BY A LABEL OF ONE COVER POLICY ADEQUATE FOR THAT WORLD; DECODE (t,label) TO THAT POLICY. THIS SUCCEEDS ON EVERY WORLD.

zero_persistence_criterion.exact_finite_condition: B_star = 0 IFF FOR EVERY EFFECTIVE JIT TRANSCRIPT CELL W_t THERE EXISTS AT LEAST ONE POLICY ADEQUATE FOR EVERY WORLD IN THAT CELL
zero_persistence_criterion.interpretation: ZERO PERSISTENT TASK MESSAGE IS POSSIBLE EXACTLY WHEN THE COMPLETE NONPERSISTENT TRANSCRIPT ALREADY COLLAPSES EACH REMAINING AMBIGUITY CLASS TO A COMMON-ACTION CLASS.
zero_persistence_criterion.important_distinction: PAIRWISE POLICY COMPATIBILITY IS INSUFFICIENT; A WHOLE CELL MUST HAVE A COMMON ADEQUATE POLICY OR BE PARTITIONED BY PERSISTENT MESSAGE.

relation_to_resource_capacity_cut.repair: THE PRIOR R*S*C>=tau RESULT IS A COARSE NECESSARY CARDINALITY LOWER BOUND AND EXPLICITLY NOT A GENERAL SUFFICIENCY THEOREM. S*C>=tau MAY MAKE THAT LOWER BOUND ZERO WHILE ZERO PERSISTENCE IS STILL IMPOSSIBLE BECAUSE THE SEPARATOR PARTITION IS STRUCTURALLY MISALIGNED WITH POLICY ADEQUACY.
relation_to_resource_capacity_cut.counterexample: TWO TRANSCRIPT CELLS EACH CONTAIN TWO WORLDS REQUIRING DISJOINT POLICIES. GLOBAL tau=2 AND S=2 SATISFY S>=tau, YET EACH CELL HAS tau_t=2, SO ONE PERSISTENT BIT IS STILL NECESSARY.
relation_to_resource_capacity_cut.compute_rule: DETERMINISTIC SUFFIX COMPUTE CANNOT CREATE WORLD-DISTINGUISHING INFORMATION. IF A TEST OR VERIFIER PRODUCES WORLD-DEPENDENT OUTCOMES BEFORE COMMITMENT, THOSE OUTCOMES BELONG IN THE EFFECTIVE TRANSCRIPT T. IF IT IS PURE COMPUTATION FROM T AND THE FROZEN KERNEL, ITS BENEFIT IS ALREADY REFLECTED IN THE ADEQUATE-POLICY RELATION FOR THAT CELL.

capability_bytes_consequence.rule: B_star COUNTS TASK MESSAGE BITS. ZERO INCREMENTAL PERSISTENT CAPABILITY BYTES CAN STILL HOLD WITH B_star>0 ONLY IF THE MESSAGE IS INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AS TASK-SPECIFIC NONCAPABILITY STATE AND THE FROZEN KERNEL PLUS ADMISSIBLE JIT KNOWLEDGE COMPUTES THE DECODER WITHOUT NEW DURABLE CAPABILITY-BEARING ARTIFACTS.
capability_bytes_consequence.anti_smuggling: INSTANCE-SPECIFIC DECODER TABLES, PROCEDURES, POLICIES, OR VERIFIERS CANNOT BE EXCLUDED AS 'KNOWLEDGE' MERELY BY STORAGE LOCATION. IF THEY PROVIDE REUSABLE PROCEDURAL COMPETENCE, THEY ARE CAPABILITY-BEARING UNDER STRONG BYTES ACCOUNTING.
